Blondie – Call Me

Original 1980 Chrysalis Records 7-inch 45 RPM single featuring Blondie's chart-topping hit "Call Me," the iconic theme from the Paramount Pictures film American Gigolo. Includes the original factory picture sleeve.

Produced by the legendary Giorgio Moroder, this remains one of Blondie's signature songs and a staple of 1980s New Wave collections.

Tracks

Side A

  • Call Me (Theme from American Gigolo) – 3:30
